top_signals.title: Broadcom Sees AI Chip Boom as It Takes On Nvidia | The Pulse 9/3/2026
top_signals.summary:
"The Pulse With Francine Lacqua" is all about conversations with high profile guests in the beating heart of global business, economics, finance and politics. Based in London, we go wherever the story is, bringing you exclusive interviews and market-moving scoops.

Today's guests: Claudia Panseri, UBS Wealth Management France CIO; Richard Portes, London Business School Professor of Economics; Tina Fordham, Fordham Global Foresight Founder and Geopolitical Strategist; Elina Ribakova, Peterson Institute for International Economics Senior Fellow (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Gloria Steinem, Stalwart of US Feminist Movement, Dies at 92
top_signals.summary: Gloria Steinem, who championed the cause of equal rights for women for more than six decades using her skills as a writer, activist and public speaker, has died. She was 92.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
